title: Token.identityRegistry points to IdentityRegistry
desc: Token exposes identityRegistry() and equals deployed IdentityRegistry

title: Trusted issuer list non-empty for used topics
desc: For each topic in CTR, TIR.getTrustedIssuersForClaimTopic(topic) length >= 1

title: Admin wiring functions gated
desc: Setters like setIdentityRegistry/setClaimTopicsRegistry restricted to owner/agent (surface presence check only)

title: Events for administrative actions
desc: IR/CTR/TIR emit events on updates (surface presence of event signatures only)

title: Compliance swap hooks exist
desc: Token.setCompliance(address) present; compliance has bind/unbind functions

title: Zero-address guard surfaces
desc: Setters expected to revert on zero address (surface only; LLM to reason over docstrings)

title: Decimals/name/symbol sane
desc: decimals in [0..18], name and symbol non-empty
